name: Ta-da★It's the Fairy!
descriptionTemplate: [{Devour}: Gain 1 stack of {Satiety}. For each instance of DMG dealt by Exalt, inflicts [Corrosion:Arg10] stacks of {Corrosion} equal to the DMG dealt after Exalt concludes.] Dispel {Burn} from all cards in hand. Gain [Block:Arg2] Shield. Deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG [Arg8] times to all enemies. Each stack of {Satiety} increases Exalt Base DMG and Shield Generation by [Arg6]%. Consume all {Offering} stacks; each stack increases Exalt hit count by 1 and converts into an equal number of stacks of {Satiety}.
lore:
The fairy and the wizard crossed paths on a desolate patch of ground in the corner of some little town.
She was smilingly beckoning to finely-dressed foreign children, while the wizard had his eyes fixed on the jingling gold bracelet on their mother's wrist.
Their gazes met in the air, and in an instant, each understood the other's intent.
In this silent contest, the wizard proved the more skilled, edging out a narrow victory on the strength of his seasoned experience.
And thus, a brand-new, beautiful enterprise of swindling and scamming raised its curtain.
